review.wirePersistenceRuntimeImpact: No wire-format change. Adds versioned profile ownership/selectors and opaque credential references, native protected secret storage, five Developer-gated Tauri commands, and the R8-kept Android credential JNI bridge. Mode changes serialize with identity/interface lifecycle, commit after readiness, retain unlocked identity only for same-profile rebuild, and verify rollback. External clients authenticate without fallback and reject local interface changes. New managed profiles are standalone; existing private sharing and operator selectors are preserved. AutoInterface UDP remains unchanged. Retains the previously reviewed announce/readiness boundaries and BLE firmware startup policy. Failed Link/packet recovery now uses the transport's bounded exact-attempt owner, with no ordinary receive-interface quarantine. Atomic packet receipts retain validated proofs across retry queues; canonical first-hop timing drives packet and Link deadlines, while bounded protocol clocks take precedence over orphan watchdogs. Packet RTT still reaches DB, UI events and Activity. No new UI setting, wire format, native dependency or Auto delivery policy change.

Version 1 bounded native queue uses Android Keystore AES-GCM and AtomicFile in noBackupFilesDir.
